optimizedContext.value:
# python-language-adapter

## Rules

### Scope & Analysis
- Handles `.py`, `.pyi` as `python`.
- Single-pass parsing via Tree-sitter/ast-grep; returns `FileAnalysisDraft` without AST retention or module execution.

### Declarations & Owners
- Extracts module functions, classes, nested classes, methods, module assignments. Drops nested functions in function bodies & class assignments.
- Complete construct range; declared-name `selectionRange`. Attached comments preserved.
- Declaring owner = nearest enclosing class. Same-name methods distinct across classes. Top-level declarations have no owner.
- Classifies `@classmethod`, `@staticmethod`, properties, setters; omits unknown decorators.

### Imports & Package Resolution
- Extracts `import`, `from ... import ...`, aliases, relative imports, literal `importlib.import_module()` & `__import__()`. Drops variable dynamic imports.
- Relative imports handle leading dots, package `__init__.py`, stubs, `src/` layouts.
- Reads `pyproject.toml` `name` (with `_`/`-` normalization) bounded by repo root.

### Scoped Bindings, Calls & Relations
- Emits facts for scope, params, return/assignment annotations, `self`/`cls` receivers, `new` construction calls.
- Emits `IMPORTS`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE` only when proven by indexed facts.
- Innermost function/method = caller. Drops module-scope calls, monkey patching, reflection, dynamic attributes.

### Hierarchy & Evidence
- Preserves declared base order. Emits `EXTENDS` (class), `IMPLEMENTS` (protocol/interface), `OVERRIDES` (method replacement).
- Reference facts retain child owner, base order, ancestor/contract owner, relation kind, provenance steps.
- C3 MRO / descriptors / `__mro_entries__` unsupported -> complex dynamic bases remain `ambiguous` or `unresolved`. Cycle-safe.
- Advertises `hierarchy: true`, `buildContext: false`.

### Public Surface & Stubs
- `.pyi` stubs participate without runtime execution. `__all__`, star exports, namespace packages unsupported unless explicitly proven. No underscore-name heuristic guessing.

## Constraints
- NO Python module execution, imports, or runtime inspection.
- Monkey patching, dynamic attribute hooks, reflection, interprocedural flow -> unsupported.
- Python-specific logic MUST stay inside adapter.
